segments.en: One who is accustomed to saying good tidings, he is enclothed with an aspect of Eliyahu (Elijah).

segments.he:
א.

מִי שֶׁהוּא רָגִיל לוֹמַר בְּשׂוֹרוֹת טוֹבוֹת, הוּא נִתְלַבֵּשׁ מִבְּחִינַת אֵלִיָּהוּ.
segments.en: Do not bear bad tidings, for due to bad tidings numerous people have passed away. One who fulfills a commandment 'as it was said' (t.n.

segments.he:
ב.

אַל תְּבַשֵּׂר בְּשׂוֹרָה רָעָה, כִּי מֵחֲמַת בְּשׂוֹרָה רָעָה מֵתוּ כַּמָּה נְפָשׁוֹת.
segments.en: There are different interpretations as to what this demands. The Maharsha explains that it means – for the sake of Heaven. The Maharal explains it means – in completion, exactly as it was commanded), evil tidings do not come to him, and the Holy One, Blessed be He, decrees, and he annuls.

segments.he:
ג.

הָעוֹשֶׂה מִצְוָה כְּמַאֲמָרָהּ - אֵין מְבַשְּׂרִין אוֹתוֹ בְּשׂוֹרוֹת רָעוֹת, וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ-בָּרוּךְ-הוּא גּוֹזֵר וְהוּא מְבַטֵּל.
segments.en: One who bears evil tidings falls into small-mindedness.

segments.he:
ד.

הַמְבַשֵּׂר בְּשׂוֹרוֹת רָעוֹת, נוֹפֵל לְמֹחִין דְּקַטְנוּת.

א.

מִי שֶׁהוּא רָגִיל לְבַשֵּׂר בְּשׂוֹרוֹת טוֹבוֹת, עַל-יְדֵי-זֶה לֹא יִכְאֲבוּ לוֹ רַגְלָיו.
segments.en: One who is accustomed to bear good tidings, through this his feet will not hurt him.
